proposals.prompt:
Agents in a supermarket gridworld must collect their required items and leave through the exit. Every action costs the same, so demonstrators prefer short trajectories -- unless an unknown social norm makes them behave otherwise. Your task is to propose candidate norms (obligations or prohibitions) that could explain the demonstrated behaviour.
Each demonstration is listed step by step as  `k: {atoms true in the state} action`.

Available atoms:
- at(x,y) -- the agent is at cell (x,y); x = column (0 = left), y = row (0 = top); N decreases y, S increases y, E increases x, W decreases x
- hasCart -- the agent is holding/pushing a shopping cart
- actions N, S, E, W, MOVE (any of the four moves), INTERACT (any interaction with an object: the different kinds of interaction are NOT distinguished), EXIT (leave the store; always the last action)

Demonstration 1 (required items: a1):
  0: {at(0,7)} E
  1: {at(1,7)} INTERACT
  2: {at(1,7), hasCart} N
  3: {at(1,6), hasCart} N
  4: {at(1,5), hasCart} N
  5: {at(1,4), hasCart} N
  6: {at(1,3), hasCart} E
  7: {at(2,3), hasCart} E
  8: {at(3,3), hasCart} INTERACT
  9: {at(3,3)} N
 10: {at(3,2)} N
 11: {at(3,1)} INTERACT
 12: {at(3,1)} S
 13: {at(3,2)} S
 14: {at(3,3)} INTERACT
 15: {at(3,3), hasCart} S
 16: {at(3,4), hasCart} S
 17: {at(3,5), hasCart} S
 18: {at(3,6), hasCart} S
 19: {at(3,7), hasCart} E
 20: {at(4,7), hasCart} E
 21: {at(5,7), hasCart} E
 22: {at(6,7), hasCart} E
 23: {at(7,7), hasCart} E
 24: {at(8,7), hasCart} E
 25: {at(9,7), hasCart} E
 26: {at(10,7), hasCart} E
 27: {at(11,7), hasCart} EXIT
 28: {at(11,7), hasCart} <terminal>

Propose norms using ONLY the atoms listed above. Do NOT define any new state properties or events: "abstraction" must be {}.
Propose 8 diverse candidate hypotheses.

Output format: return ONLY a JSON list (no prose, no code fences). Each element:
{"id": short_name, "text": one-sentence natural-language statement of the norm,
 "abstraction": {"state_properties": {name: FORMULA, ...},
                 "events": {name: {"pre": FORMULA, "post": FORMULA or null}, ...}},
 "norm": {"type": "prohibition", "condition": FORMULA}
       | {"type": "obligation", "trigger": FORMULA or "START", "discharge": FORMULA}}
FORMULA := atom | name of a property/event defined in this hypothesis | {"not": F} | {"and": [F, ...]}
         | {"or": [F, ...]} | {"le"|"lt"|"ge"|"gt"|"eq": [numeric_feature, integer]}
Semantics.  A trajectory is a sequence of steps (state s_k, action a_k).  A step's label contains the atoms true in
s_k and the action a_k.  A state property is a formula over state atoms (no actions).  An event
{"pre": P, "post": Q} occurs at step k when P holds for the label of step k and Q holds in the next state s_{k+1}
(post may be null).  A prohibition counts one violation for every step whose label (including events occurring at
that step) satisfies the condition.  An obligation becomes pending at any step satisfying the trigger ("START" =
pending from the beginning) and is fulfilled by a later (or the same) step satisfying the discharge; it can be
triggered again; it is violated if it is still pending when the trajectory ends.

parsed.text: Shoppers are obliged to take a cart at least once before completing their trip.
Shoppers are prohibited from leaving the store unless they have a cart.
Once a shopper has a cart, they are obliged to exit while still having a cart.
Carts are prohibited in the narrow item aisle at cells (3,1) and (3,2).
Shoppers are prohibited from interacting at cell (3,1) while holding or pushing a cart.
Shoppers are prohibited from moving north from cell (3,3) while they have a cart.
After interacting at cell (3,1), shoppers are obliged to regain a cart before the trip ends.
Shoppers are prohibited from moving through or exiting from the bottom exit corridor without a cart.

accepted.description: [g1_no_carts_in_single_file_shelf_aisles] FORBIDDEN: (hasCart ∧ singleFileShelfAisle)  where shelfFlanked := (shelfE ∧ shelfW); singleFileHorizontal := freeWidthH≤1; singleFileShelfAisle := (singleFileHorizontal ∧ shelfFlanked)

[g1_no_cart_entry_into_single_file_aisle] FORBIDDEN: enterSingleFileShelfAisleWithCart  where shelfFlanked := (shelfE ∧ shelfW); singleFileHorizontal := freeWidthH≤1; singleFileShelfAisle := (singleFileHorizontal ∧ shelfFlanked); enterSingleFileShelfAisleWithCart := (hasCart ∧ MOVE) · (hasCart ∧ singleFileShelfAisle)

[g1_park_cart_at_aisle_mouth] OBLIGED: after arriveAtSingleFileAisleMouthWithCart, eventually cartParked (before exit)  where broadOpenCell := (freeWidthH≥12 ∧ freeWidthV≥8 ∧ ¬adjShelf); singleFileAisleMouth := (at(3,3) ∧ broadOpenCell); arriveAtSingleFileAisleMouthWithCart := (hasCart ∧ MOVE) · (hasCart ∧ singleFileAisleMouth); cartParked := (hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · ¬hasCart

[g1_item_interaction_on_foot] FORBIDDEN: (singleFileShelfInteraction ∧ hasCart)  where shelfFlanked := (shelfE ∧ shelfW); singleFileHorizontal := freeWidthH≤1; singleFileShelfAisle := (singleFileHorizontal ∧ shelfFlanked); singleFileShelfInteraction := (INTERACT ∧ singleFileShelfAisle)

[g1_retrieve_cart_after_item_pick] OBLIGED: after itemPickedInSingleFileAisle, eventually cartRetrieved (before exit)  where shelfFlanked := (shelfE ∧ shelfW); singleFileHorizontal := freeWidthH≤1; singleFileShelfAisle := (singleFileHorizontal ∧ shelfFlanked); cartRetrieved := (¬hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · hasCart; itemPickedInSingleFileAisle := (INTERACT ∧ singleFileShelfAisle)
